scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,web "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w firebase/functions && scripts/fb.sh emulators:start --project demo-flack --only auth,firestore,database,storage,functions,pubsub
scripts.build: npm run build -w firebase/functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run build -w firebase/functions && npm run build -w telemetry/functions
scripts.test:unit: npm test -w web && npm test -w firebase/functions && npm test -w telemetry/functions
scripts.test:emu: npm run build -w firebase/functions && scripts/fb.sh emulators:exec --project demo-flack --only auth,firestore,database,storage,functions,pubsub "npm test -w firebase/rules-tests"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emu
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w firebase/functions && scripts/fb.sh emulators:exec --project demo-flack --only auth,firestore,database,storage,functions,pubsub "npm test -w e2e"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e && npm run build && node scripts/check-build.mjs
